occupation: Workers Employed in Shops & Catering Establishments
Workers Engaged in Bricks and Tiles Manufacturing
Workers Engaged in Distribution of Liquid Petroleum Gas Cylinder
other_conditions: Applicant must be the nominee of the deceased worker.
Deceased must have been a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
Deceased must have been an unorganized worker in the specified occupations.
Deceased must have been enrolled with the Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society.
Deceased must have been aged between 18 and 59 years during his/her lifetime.
Deceased must have taken an annual subscription of ₹100 each year.
Deceased must have paid a registration fee of ₹25.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹7,000 to the nominee of the deceased worker for funeral expenses, credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
